Meteora operates on the Solana blockchain. Meteora provides automated market maker liquidity pools. Meteora offers dynamic liquidity market maker pools for trading.

dYdX operates as a decentralized exchange for perpetual derivatives. dYdX matches orders through an off-chain order book with on-chain settlement. dYdX runs its own Cosmos-based app chain.

Autofarm operates as a yield aggregator. Autofarm auto-compounds yield farming rewards for users. Autofarm has been deployed on the BNB Smart Chain.

Spool Protocol operates as a yield optimization protocol. Spool Protocol deploys user funds into automated yield strategies. Spool Protocol is deployed on the Ethereum blockchain.
